newsitem.title: CHINA: China October industry output up 13.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China October industry output up 13.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's industrial output rose 13.3 percent year-on-year to 164.1 billion yuan in October, the State Statistical Bureau said on Thursday.
The State Statistical Bureau previously reported January to September industrial output growth as 12.9 percent. It did not give a figure for September alone.
The bureau said state-owned enterprises showed output growth of 8.3 percent in October after posting a rise of 5.5 percent in the January-September period.

Collective industry recorded output growth of 16.6 percent in the month alone compared with 17.9 percent over the first nine months. Private industry's growth was 11.5 percent in the month compared with a nine-month level of 13.4 percent.
The bureau also said that the ratio of sales to production was 96.27 percent in October, up 0.37 percentage point from the same month last year.
Production of primary energy products was up 6.9 percent in October over the same month last year, with coal rising 7.3 percent and crude oil increasing 4.7 percent.
Steel products showed a gain of 11.8 percent while copper products were up 6.0 percent and aluminium products rose by 15.9 percent.
Appliances also showed output gains, with air-conditioners jumping 81.9 percent.
However, the bureau said that domestic industry faced problems of low quality output.
Profitability showed an overall decline while the extent of losses by enterprises increased. It gave no further details.
